meta.name: Amor en las Nubes
meta.description: En los Seis Reinos de Hexu, durante la anual "Conferencia Nubes", Ji Bozai (interpretado por Hou Minghao) —un combatiente de Jixingyuan con antecedentes de reo— logra derrotar de un solo golpe a Ming Yi (Lu Yuxiao), la diosa guerrera invicta durante siete años. De la noche a la mañana, Ji Bozai se convierte en la estrella más aclamada de Jixingyuan. Mientras tanto, Ming Yi oculta su verdadera identidad y se disfraza de bailarina para acercarse a Ji Bozai. Con ambos envueltos en secretos, su feroz enfrentamiento se enciende con pasión y amor, defendiendo la justicia hasta culminar en una conmovedora historia romántica.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: Ming Xian, in disguise, loses the Qingyun Martial Arts Tournament and suspects someone poisoned her. To find the antidote, she assumes a new identity.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Under her new alias, Ming Yi tries to divert attention away from her investigation of Wugui Sea — but Ji Bozai is suspicious of her.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: After Ji Bozai catches Ming Yi eavesdropping, he puts her to the test. He also learns the truth about his master's death and Houzhao's true intentions.

videos.title: Episodio 4
videos.overview: Ming Yi learns more about the whereabouts of the antidote — but to retrieve it, she must get closer to Ji Bozai and concocts a plan to gain his trust.

videos.title: Episodio 5
videos.overview: Ming Yi and Ji Bozai grow closer after she injures herself while helping him steal his master's portrait. Yan Xiao stops Tianji from visiting her father.

videos.title: Episodio 6
videos.overview: Yan Xiao rescues Tianji, revealing his true feelings. As Ming Yi's real identity threatens to surface, Ji Bozai's plan begins to take shape.

videos.title: Episodio 7
videos.overview: Ming Yi realizes Ji Bozai feels guilty for using her. As the court presses for the antidote, she discovers that someone knows her true name.

videos.title: Episodio 8
videos.overview: Situ Ling agrees to protect Ming Yi's identity. When she takes drastic measures to defend Wugui Sea, others misunderstand her intentions.

videos.title: Episodio 9
videos.overview: Ji Bozai and Ming Yi must work together to save Zhang Tai from Xun Ming, who has captured him in hopes of resurrecting his beloved late wife.

videos.title: Episodio 10
videos.overview: While stuck in Xun Ming's illusion maze, Ji Bozai and Ming Yi make a shocking discovery about his marriage to Xinliu that puts Ji Bozai in danger.

videos.title: Episodio 11
videos.overview: Ji Bozai and Ming Yi work to expose the truth about Xun Ming's marriage to Xinliu, while also navigating their true feelings for each other.

videos.title: Episodio 12
videos.overview: Situ Ling stirs drama amid Ji Bozai and Ming Yi's relationship, which is only growing stronger. Ming Yi finds a disturbing letter from Xin Liu.

videos.title: Episodio 13
videos.overview: In the Sunken Abyss, Twenty-Seven's mission goes wrong. Meanwhile, Mu Qibai reveals Ming Yi's identity and exposes a secret Ji Bozai holds.

videos.title: Episodio 14
videos.overview: Heavenly punishment strikes Ji Bozai, and Ming Yi risks everything to save him. Later, they reach an agreement to work together and expose Mu Qibai.

videos.title: Episodio 15
videos.overview: Mu Qibai captures commoners for his own evil plan. Twenty-Seven discovers the location of the Soul-Eating Tree. Ji Bozai uncovers a shocking murder.

videos.title: Episodio 16
videos.overview: When Ji Bozai resolves to avenge the Sunken Abyss, Ming Yi offers aid by dealing with Mu Qibai. Situ Ling's obscured heritage comes to light.

videos.title: Episodio 17
videos.overview: Ji Bozai struggles with his own inner demons while trying to absorb the demon beast. Tian Ji teams up with Ming Yi after an unexpected danger arises.

videos.title: Episodio 18
videos.overview: When Ji Bozai regains clarity, Ming Yi stays by his side. Mu Qibai's men seek to confront Ji Bozai, and Mu Qibai uses Ming Yi as a bargaining chip.

videos.title: Episodio 19
videos.overview: Sun Liao sets a trap for Ming Yi and interrogates her under a powerful spell. Ji Bozai rescues her and hears a startling confession.

videos.title: Episodio 20
videos.overview: After regaining her senses, Ming Yi avoids Ji Bozai. Twenty-Seven urges her to focus on the antidote, while Ji Bozai makes a declaration of his own.

videos.title: Episodio 21
videos.overview: Summoning a demon beast, Mu Qibai attacks during a festival, stoking chaos at Ji Xing Abyss. Fighting back, Ming Yi wields a demon-sealing instrument.

videos.title: Episodio 22
videos.overview: Ji Bozai and Ming Yi confront the demon, but the encounter leaves them shaken. Ji Bozai opens up to Ming Yi, yet she remains torn about her desires.

videos.title: Episodio 23
videos.overview: An unexpected clash between Ji Bozai and Ming Yi changes the course of their relationship. Tian Ji uncovers the secret of the Fortune Flower.

videos.title: Episodio 24
videos.overview: Situ Ling agrees to help Ming Yi find a different source for the Golden Millet Dream. Ming Yi travels into the Sunken Abyss with She Tianlin to find it.

videos.title: Episodio 25
videos.overview: Situ Ling sets off a chain of events that puts the Sunken Abyss region in peril. When Ji Bozai learns that Ming Yi is in danger, he rushes to her rescue.

videos.title: Episodio 26
videos.overview: Ji Bozai forces Ming Yi to make a confession to him. But danger soon arises when they encounter a Candle Dragon and a troubling incident of poisoning.

videos.title: Episodio 27
videos.overview: Situ Ling uses a fox clan technique to heal Ming Yi but it comes with consequences. Ji Bozai pledges support to Tianji and later uncovers a secret.

videos.title: Episodio 28
videos.overview: Still suffering from the effects of the Sorrow Toxin, Ji Bozai helps Ming Yi recover and together they partially restore the Mirror of Affairs.

videos.title: Episodio 29
videos.overview: Situ Ling and Ming Xin strike a deal. Bu Xiu enters a competition to win the materials needed to revive Twenty-Seven. Ji Bozai and Ming Yi reconcile.

videos.title: Episodio 30
videos.overview: Lost pieces of Ming Yi's history come to light and she enlists Jing Shu to help uncover the mystery of what happened a generation ago.

videos.title: Episodio 31
videos.overview: Ming Yi and Ji Bozai learn the truth about the crown prince, but the fallout from this revelation comes with dire consequences for both.

videos.title: Episodio 32
videos.overview: Ji Bozai makes a sacrifice and accepts his path to protect everyone else. Meanwhile, turmoil hits the Qing Yun Tournament audition.

videos.title: Episodio 33
videos.overview: Ming Yi enters the tournament battles with her true identity exposed. At Zhang Tai's wedding, romance and tragedy unfold around Ji Bozai.

videos.title: Episodio 34
videos.overview: Ming Yi makes a difficult choice to save Ji Bozai as a revolt against the Divine Lord of Zhu Shui begins, with a vengeful Situ Ling at the helm.

videos.title: Episodio 35
videos.overview: Ming Yi and Ji Bozai decide to face the Heaven-Devouring Array together, while a desperate Situ Ling takes drastic measures to fight against them.

videos.title: Episodio 36
videos.overview: As the Heaven-Devouring Array closes in, Ji Bozai and Ming Yi uncover the past with Lin Ziyao's help and together decide what their future will hold.
